hasPart.name: According to the content, how long does it typically take for new precious metals discoveries to reach production?
hasPart.text: According to the content, how long does it typically take for new precious metals discoveries to reach production?

comment.text: New discoveries take 7-15 years to reach production, meaning current high prices won't increase supply quickly, supporting fundamental price strength.

hasPart.name: What acquisition did Sibanye-Stillwater make that demonstrates the industry shift toward recycling?
hasPart.text: What acquisition did Sibanye-Stillwater make that demonstrates the industry shift toward recycling?

acceptedAnswer.text: $82 million acquisition of US precious metals recycler Metallix

comment.text: Sibanye-Stillwater's $82 million acquisition of US precious metals recycler Metallix demonstrates how mining companies are investing heavily in secondary supply.

suggestedAnswer.text: $50 million purchase of a mining company
$100 million investment in new mining equipment

hasPart.name: According to the content, how much have global central banks been purchasing gold annually?
hasPart.text: According to the content, how much have global central banks been purchasing gold annually?

comment.text: Global central banks are maintaining gold buying at levels not seen since the end of the gold standard, with over 1,000 tonnes purchased annually.

hasPart.name: What percentage did silver jewelry demand collapse compared to 2024 due to high prices?
hasPart.text: What percentage did silver jewelry demand collapse compared to 2024 due to high prices?

comment.text: Silver jewelry demand collapsed 50% compared to 2024 due to high prices, while industrial applications continue supporting fundamental demand.

hasPart.name: According to NDR's Tim Hayes, what positioning strategy remains structurally attractive?
hasPart.text: According to NDR's Tim Hayes, what positioning strategy remains structurally attractive?

comment.text: Professional analysts like NDR's Tim Hayes suggest the "long gold/short dollar" positioning strategy remains structurally attractive.

hasPart.name: What is the key insight about Federal Reserve credibility mentioned in the content?
hasPart.text: What is the key insight about Federal Reserve credibility mentioned in the content?

acceptedAnswer.text: Political pressure on Fed independence is creating credibility concerns

comment.text: Political pressure on Federal Reserve independence is creating institutional credibility concerns that historically drive safe-haven demand for precious metals.

suggestedAnswer.text: Fed credibility is at all-time highs
Fed independence has never been stronger

hasPart.name: How much did Russia's precious metals exports to China increase in the first half of 2025?
hasPart.text: How much did Russia's precious metals exports to China increase in the first half of 2025?

comment.text: Russia's precious metals exports to China nearly doubled to $1 billion in first half of 2025, demonstrating how geopolitical sanctions create new trade patterns.

hasPart.name: True or False: Central banks rarely sell gold once purchased, removing supply permanently from markets.
hasPart.text: True or False: Central banks rarely sell gold once purchased, removing supply permanently from markets.

comment.text: Unlike private investors, central banks rarely sell gold once purchased, removing supply permanently from markets and providing structural demand support.
